HostFunctionDeclaration.title: HostFunctionDeclaration
HostFunctionDeclaration.description: Host-function contract entry: the function, what it does, and the resource scope a grant must carry (null when ambient).

HostFunctionId.title: HostFunctionId
HostFunctionId.description: Host function id: capability.invoke, clock.read, evidence.append, log.write, storage.read, storage.write, or world.read.

ResourceScope.title: ResourceScope
ResourceScope.description: Typed resource scope: a legal (domain, access) pair a grant carries for host calls to be permitted. The v1 host surface offers no direct world mutation.

ResourceDomain.title: ResourceDomain
ResourceDomain.description: Resource domain a sandboxed extension can touch: world, evidence, storage, or capability.

ResourceAccess.title: ResourceAccess
ResourceAccess.description: Kind of access over a resource domain: read, append, write, or invoke.
